prompt: The attached image is a 240x294 px frame from an animated GIF. Rebuild the scene in 3D with three.js. Task (3D, static): write an HTML page that builds the scene from code and renders it so that the view from your reference camera reproduces the image as faithfully as you can: characters, poses, facial expressions, hands, props, background, and colors. A later step will animate your scene, so structure it in named groups. For this static step, render(t) may ignore t. three.js contract: - The harness injects an import map for three.js r187. Import from 'three' and from 'three/addons/'; the only addons available are 'three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ConvexGeometry.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ParametricFunctions.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ParametricGeometry.js', 'three/addons/geometries/RoundedBoxGeometry.js', 'three/addons/math/ConvexHull.js', 'three/addons/utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js'. Use one
html:
<!doctype html>

<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';

const width = 240;
const height = 294;
const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ preserveDrawingBuffer: true });
renderer.setPixelRatio(1);
renderer.setSize(width, height, false);
renderer.setClearColor(0xdad8d1);
document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

const scene = new THREE.Scene();
const ref = new THREE.OrthographicCamera(-2.4, 2.4, 2.94, -2.94, 0.1, 50);
ref.position.set(0, 0, 13);
ref.lookAt(0, 0, 0);

const backdrop = new THREE.Mesh(
  new THREE.PlaneGeometry(2, 2),
  new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
    depthTest: false,
    depthWrite: false,
    vertexShader: `
      void main() { gl_Position = vec4(position.xy, 0.99999, 1.0); }
    `,
    fragmentShader: `
      float hash(vec2 p) {
        vec3 q = fract(vec3(p.xyx) * .1031);
        q += dot(q, q.yzx + 33.33);
        return fract((q.x + q.y) * q.z);
      }
      void main() {
        vec2 p = vec2(gl_FragCoord.x, 294.0 - gl_FragCoord.y);
        float top = exp(-pow((p.y + 9.0) / 69.0, 2.0));
        float floorHaze = smoothstep(202.0, 302.0, p.y + 5.0 * sin(p.x * .024));
        float rightGlow = exp(-dot((p - vec2(210.,136.)) / vec2(101.,94.),
                                  (p - vec2(210.,136.)) / vec2(101.,94.)));
        float leftGlow = exp(-dot((p - vec2(37.,171.)) / vec2(85.,81.),
                                 (p - vec2(37.,171.)) / vec2(85.,81.)));
        vec3 c = vec3(.949,.945,.938)
               - top * vec3(.099,.092,.081)
               - floorHaze * vec3(.151,.153,.150)
               + rightGlow * vec3(.051,.056,.063)
               + leftGlow * vec3(.038,.043,.051);
        vec2 pixel = floor(gl_FragCoord.xy);
        float lattice = mod(pixel.x + pixel.y, 2.0) - .5;
        c += (hash(pixel) - .5) * .053 + lattice * .014;
        c += (vec3(hash(pixel + 17.),hash(pixel + 83.),hash(pixel + 213.)) - .5) * .024;
        gl_FragColor = vec4(c, 1.);
      }
    `
  })
);
backdrop.name = 'soft gray studio background';
backdrop.frustumCulled = false;
backdrop.renderOrder = -100;
scene.add(backdrop);

scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xfffaf1, 0xc1b2a0, 2.25));
scene.add(new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff, 0.44));
const key = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xfff3d8, 0.93);
key.position.set(-3, 6, 8);
scene.add(key);
const fill = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xf5f2ff, 0.42);
fill.position.set(5, 1, 4);
scene.add(fill);
const rim = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xfff0cb, 0.7);
rim.position.set(1, 5, -6);
scene.add(rim);

const matte = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
  vertexColors: true,
  roughness: 0.94,
  metalness: 0
});
matte.onBeforeCompile = (shader) => {
  shader.fragmentShader = shader.fragmentShader.replace(
    '#include <colorspace_fragment>',
    `#include <colorspace_fragment>
    vec2 pixel = floor(gl_FragCoord.xy);
    vec3 grainSeed = fract(vec3(pixel.xyx) * .1031);
    grainSeed += dot(grainSeed, grainSeed.yzx + 33.33);
    float grain = fract((grainSeed.x + grainSeed.y) * grainSeed.z) - .5;
    float lattice = mod(pixel.x + pixel.y, 2.0) - .5;
    gl_FragColor.rgb += grain * .044 + lattice * .010;`
  );
};

const tau = Math.PI * 2;
const channel = (hex) => new THREE.Color(hex);
const smooth = THREE.MathUtils.smoothstep;
const clamp = THREE.MathUtils.clamp;
const mix = THREE.MathUtils.lerp;
const Z = new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 1);

function at(x, y, z) {
  return new THREE.Vector3((x - 120) / 50, (147 - y) / 50, z / 50);
}

const origins = new WeakMap([[scene, new THREE.Vector3()]]);
function group(name, parent, pivot) {
  const part = new THREE.Group();
  part.name = name;
  const origin = at(...pivot);
  part.position.copy(origin).sub(origins.get(parent));
  origins.set(part, origin);
  parent.add(part);
  return part;
}

function solid(name, parent, positions, colors, indices, normals) {
  const geo = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  geo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(positions, 3));
  geo.setAttribute('color', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(colors, 3));
  geo.setIndex(indices);
  if (normals) geo.setAttribute('normal', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(normals, 3));
  else geo.computeVertexNormals();
  const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geo, matte);
  mesh.name = name;
  parent.add(mesh);
  return mesh;
}

function makeRings(rows, sides, parent, sample, pigment, capStart, capEnd, normalAt) {
  const positions = [], colors = [], indices = [];
  const normals = normalAt ? [] : null;
  const origin = origins.get(parent);

  for (let row = 0; row <= rows; row++) {
    for (let side = 0; side < sides; side++) {
      const u = row / rows;
      const angle = tau * side / sides;
      const point = sample(u, angle);
      const color = pigment(u, angle, point);
      positions.push(point.x - origin.x, point.y - origin.y, point.z - origin.z);
      colors.push(color.r, color.g, color.b);
      if (normalAt) normals.push(...normalAt(u, angle).toArray());

      if (row < rows) {
        const a = row * sides + side;
        const b = row * sides + (side + 1) % sides;
        const c = a + sides;
        const d = b + sides;
        indices.push(a, c, b, b, c, d);
      }
    }
  }

  if (capStart) {
    for (let side = 1; side < sides - 1; side++) indices.push(0, side, side + 1);
  }
  if (capEnd) {
    const end = rows * sides;
    for (let side = 1; side < sides - 1; side++) indices.push(end, end + side + 1, end + side);
  }

  return { positions, colors, indices, normals };
}

function colorRamp(stops, y) {
  let i = 0;
  while (i < stops.length - 2 && y > stops[i + 1][0]) i++;
  const [a, ca] = stops[i];
  const [b, cb] = stops[i + 1];
  return ca.clone().lerp(cb, clamp((y - a) / (b - a), 0, 1));
}

const palette = (stops) => stops.map(([y, hex]) => [y, channel(hex)]);

const character = group('character-golden-figure', scene, [102, 153, 0]);
const trunk = group('torso', character, [101, 145, 0]);
const head = group('head', character, [101, 63, 0]);

// Height, center, lateral radius, depth center, front radius, back radius.
const profile = [
  [17.2, 101.4, .18, .3, .18, .18],
  [18.8, 101.4, 9.4, .3, 7.5, 7.6],
  [22.5, 102.1, 15.1, 0, 12.1, 12.8],
  [29, 102.8, 18.3, -.3, 15.7, 16.2],
  [37, 102.8, 20.2, -.6, 17.6, 17.5],
  [46, 102.1, 22.1, -.9, 18.8, 19.1],
  [56, 100.5, 27.5, -1.5, 21.2, 22.4],
  [67, 98.9, 33.8, -2.2, 25.5, 27.1],
  [80, 98.1, 41.0, -3, 30.1, 31.5],
  [94, 97.7, 45.2, -3.7, 35.2, 35.5],
  [107, 98.7, 46.7, -4, 42.1, 38.6],
  [122, 99.8, 51.1, -3.4, 49.3, 41.3],
  [140, 101.2, 56.0, -2.3, 54.3, 43.6],
  [157, 102.3, 57.0, -1, 55.1, 45.0],
  [174, 102.8, 55.1, -.2, 52.7, 43.8],
  [191, 102.5, 50.3, 0, 46.6, 40.2],
  [207, 101.5, 43.4, -.8, 38.5, 35.3],
  [218, 100.0, 36.9, -1.3, 30.2, 29.4],
  [227, 99.9, 28.0, -2.6, 20.5, 22.3],
  [233, 99.9, 16.3, -3.2, 11.0, 14.1],
  [236, 99.9, .20, -3.5, .20, .20]
];

function section(y) {
  let i = 0;
  while (i < profile.length - 2 && y > profile[i + 1][0]) i++;
  const a = profile[i];
  const b = profile[i + 1];
  const prev = profile[Math.max(0, i - 1)];
  const next = profile[Math.min(profile.length - 1, i + 2)];
  const span = b[0] - a[0];
  const t = clamp((y - a[0]) / span, 0, 1);
  const t2 = t * t;
  const t3 = t2 * t;
  return a.slice(1).map((_, n) => {
    const k = n + 1;
    const m0 = span * (b[k] - prev[k]) / (b[0] - prev[0]);
    const m1 = span * (next[k] - a[k]) / (next[0] - a[0]);
    return (2 * t3 - 3 * t2 + 1) * a[k] + (t3 - 2 * t2 + t) * m0
         + (-2 * t3 + 3 * t2) * b[k] + (t3 - t2) * m1;
  });
}

function bodyPoint(y, angle) {
  const [center, radius, depthCenter, front, back] = section(y);
  const facing = Math.cos(angle);
  const side = Math.sin(angle);
  const x = center + radius * side;
  const nose = 1.65 * Math.exp(-Math.pow((x - 103.3) / 5.0, 2)
                              -Math.pow((y - 41.8) / 5.3, 2));
  const muzzle = .65 * Math.exp(-Math.pow((x - 103) / 10.2, 2)
                               -Math.pow((y - 49.1) / 4.9, 2));
  const z = depthCenter + facing * (facing >= 0 ? front : back)
          + Math.max(0, facing) * (nose + muzzle);
  return at(x, y, z);
}

const skin = palette([
  [17, 0xd3c05e], [35, 0xceba58], [49, 0xc8ac51],
  [68, 0xd7b756], [88, 0xe4c769], [111, 0xe3c063],
  [140, 0xe0ba61], [170, 0xd8ad55], [197, 0xd0a04a],

]);
const belly = palette([

  [148, 0xe2cea0], [164, 0xdfc48c], [180, 0xdab874],
  [196, 0xd5ac5c], [214, 0xcba04b]
]);

function bodyColor(y, angle, point) {
  const x = 120 + point.x * 50;
  const facing = Math.cos(angle);
  const dx = x - 103.0;
  const chestEdge = 91.2 + 41 * Math.pow(Math.abs(dx) / 55, 2)
                   - 1.55 * Math.sin(dx * .13) + .045 * dx;
  const bib = smooth(y, chestEdge - 3.8, chestEdge + 6.5)
            * smooth(facing, .035, .53)
            * (1 - smooth(y, 175, 220));
  const color = colorRamp(skin, y).lerp(colorRamp(belly, y), bib);
  const mouthShade = facing > 0
    ? Math.exp(-Math.pow((x - 103) / 15, 2) - Math.pow((y - 54.5) / 7.3, 2)) * .085
    : 0;
  const browShade = facing > 0
    ? Math.exp(-Math.pow((Math.abs(x - 103) - 11) / 6.2, 2)
               -Math.pow((y - 37.8) / 5.0, 2)) * .072
    : 0;
  const flecks = Math.sin(x * .19 + y * .095) * Math.sin(y * .29 - angle * 2);
  return color.multiplyScalar(1 - mouthShade - browShade + .019 * flecks);
}

function bodyPiece(name, parent, start, end, capStart, capEnd) {
  const yAt = (u) => mix(start, end, u);
  const mesh = makeRings(
    Math.ceil((end - start) * .86), 104, parent,
    (u, angle) => bodyPoint(yAt(u), angle),
    (u, angle, point) => bodyColor(yAt(u), angle, point),
    capStart, capEnd,
    (u, angle) => {
      const y = yAt(u);
      const along = bodyPoint(Math.min(236, y + .05), angle)
        .sub(bodyPoint(Math.max(17.2, y - .05), angle));
      const around = bodyPoint(y, angle + .001).sub(bodyPoint(y, angle - .001));
      return along.cross(around).normalize();
    }
  );
  solid(name, parent, mesh.positions, mesh.colors, mesh.indices, mesh.normals);
}

bodyPiece('continuous neck and torso', trunk, 63, 236, false, true);
bodyPiece('rounded head', head, 17.2, 63, true, false);

function tube(name, parent, knots, pigment, sides = 16) {
  const curve = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(knots.map(p => at(p[0], p[1], p[2])));
  const rows = Math.max(16, (knots.length - 1) * 7);
  const centers = [];
  const across = [];
  const depth = [];
  for (let i = 0; i <= rows; i++) {
    const u = i / rows;
    const tangent = curve.getTangent(u).normalize();
    centers.push(curve.getPoint(u));
    const lateral = Z.clone().cross(tangent).normalize();
    across.push(lateral);
    depth.push(tangent.clone().cross(lateral).normalize());
  }

  const mesh = makeRings(rows, sides, parent, (u, angle) => {
    const i = Math.round(u * rows);
    const along = u * (knots.length - 1);
    const k = Math.min(knots.length - 2, Math.floor(along));
    const lateralRadius = mix(knots[k][3], knots[k + 1][3], along - k) / 50;
    const depthRadius = mix(knots[k][4], knots[k + 1][4], along - k) / 50;
    return centers[i].clone()
      .addScaledVector(across[i], lateralRadius * Math.sin(angle))
      .addScaledVector(depth[i], depthRadius * Math.cos(angle));
  }, (u, angle, p) => pigment(147 - p.y * 50, angle, u), true, true);
  solid(name, parent, mesh.positions, mesh.colors, mesh.indices, mesh.normals);
}

function faceDepth(x, y) {
  const [center, radius] = section(y);
  return bodyPoint(y, Math.asin(clamp((x - center) / radius, -.995, .995))).z * 50;
}

function faceLine(name, parent, coords, hex) {
  const color = channel(hex);
  tube(name, parent, coords.map(([x, y, offset, radius, depth]) =>
    [x, y, faceDepth(x, y) + offset, radius, depth]), () => color, 12);
}
